review:
A ghost story: you come back to your empty family home, find old toys and a strange notebook, and head up to a haunted attic for the bonus. It plays on 10 lines, book-slot style.

Free spins give 10 spins with expanding toy symbols. The bonus buy is unusually flexible – choose 1, 2, 4 or 8 expanding symbols at rising prices, basically picking your own risk. Very high volatility, 7,500x max and a strong 96.89% RTP. Free spins about once every 173 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
